concerns.text: Coverage is computed after **excluding REML convergence failures** (FR‑006). Conditioning the coverage outcome on a predictor (convergence flag) biases the coverage estimate upward because difficult replicates are omitted. The validation target (coverage) is no longer independent of the predictor, making the assessment of REML performance circular.

Bonferroni correction is applied only across the five τ² levels (FR‑007), but coverage is evaluated separately for each of the three estimators (Fixed‑Effects, DerSimonian‑Laird, REML). This ignores the multiplicity across estimators (15 tests total), inflating the family‑wise Type I error rate. The correction should account for all hypothesis tests performed.
